summary: autotel-terminal@31.0.0: static patterns match on bundled CLI without traced corroboration
details: The package ships a bundled CLI (dist/cli.js and dist/cli.cjs) that contains Buffer.from(..., 'base64').toString(...) decoding and multiple HTTP POST calls alongside a 'ping' string literal. These primitives co-occur in a bundled single-file CLI, but the specific installer-side data being read and the specific destination hosts receiving POSTs are not established from the available evidence. The base64 decoding and POST calls are consistent with either an ordinary CLI performing authenticated HTTP requests or with exfiltration; the pattern alone does not determine which. No lifecycle-script auto-execution path, no reads of installer credential paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc), and no hardcoded attacker C2 endpoints are identified in the available signals.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
